thread:
Maya Patel: Quick thread to lock owners for the metering postmortem actions. Root cause was delayed token ingest -> burst re-ingest -> invoice noise. Need owners + realistic ETAs so finance can plan credits/invoices.

Maya Patel: Actions I pulled together:
• fix ingest consumer retry behavior
• run ledger backfill for the 48hr gap
• tag & correct affected invoices, apply credits per policy
• add latency/regression alert and dashboard
• start a 14-day rolling audit to detect recurrence

Omar Ruiz: I can own the consumer fix. Found the issue: exponential retries from failed DB writes caused backlog. Implementing a capped backoff + dead-lettering for bad messages. PR 512. Canary in staging tomorrow, production Fri noon PT.

Leah Walker: I'll own invoice corrections and credit ops. Need the backfill output CSV with original vs corrected token counts, and a list of impacted accounts > $250. Will draft customer notification templates after I see sample dry-run. ETA: template draft Fri AM, apply corrections Fri afternoon.

Maya Patel: @Leah Walker good. Leah, finance wants a tagging convention: add note "metering-correction" and include TKT ID and delta amount in the invoice memo.

Leah Walker: Got it. Will add that to the template.

Omar Ruiz: For alerts I added metering.consumer.p95 and metering.ingest.backlog > 1000 as thresholds. Hooked to eng-oncall and created a short runbook (PR 515).

eng-bot: Incident logged: MET-2025-03-28; ticket #TKT-2589; scheduled backfill window Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC. Linked PRs 512,515.

Maya Patel: Backfill owner? We need someone to run job and post dry-run results. Also ensure a rollback plan.

Leah Walker: I can coordinate but need an eng runbook and a staging dry-run result before approvals.

Omar Ruiz: I'll prepare the backfill tool and a --dry-run flag that emits a reconciled CSV and checksum. Recommend staging dry-run tonight against a 10-account sample.

Leah Walker: Perfect. If the deltas are >$100 for an account, auto-apply credit; otherwise queue for CS review. I'll finalize that policy doc and post link here once done.

Maya Patel: Recurrence check: Omar, can you scan the last 30 days for similar backlog spikes and post a plot? We need to know if this is recurring.

Omar Ruiz: Running now. Preliminary: two smaller, short lived spikes in last 30 days, likely transient. Will share full chart by EOD and recommend adding rate-limits on the DB write path if we see more.

Leah Walker: Finance note: please include original invoice IDs in the backfill CSV so we can reconcile. Also request that all corrected invoices get a new line item labeled "metering adjustment" to preserve audit trail.

Maya Patel: Summary of owners/ETAs:
• consumer retry fix: Omar 12 (canary tomorrow), prod Fri noon PT
• backfill tooling & staging dry-run: Omar 12 tonight; prod run Sat 02:00 UTC
• runback/backfill execution: Omar (exec) + Leah (finance signoff) Sat window
• invoice corrections & credits: Leah 12 templates Fri AM, corrections Sat morning after backfill
• alerts + runbook: Omar 12 merged
• 14-day rolling audit: Maya to kick off after backfill, cadence weekly check-ins

Maya Patel: If anyone cannot meet these, flag here. I'll file the remediation plan in the postmortem doc and mark actions as assigned. Thanks all.

Leah Walker: On it. Will post template link shortly.

Omar Ruiz: Staging dry-run complete, sending CSV to Leah. No surprises in samples. Ready for prod window.

eng-bot: Backfill job started at 2025-04-05T02:00:12Z.

Leah Walker: Backfill finished. I validated sample reconciliations. Preparing invoice adjustments now.

Maya Patel: Great work team. We'll re-open if any issues crop up during the 14-day audit. :white_check_mark:
